display.summary: The password prompt opens above the Operations panel, so restart and recreate can be confirmed.
highlights: The shared password prompt stacks above any open modal; in 1.13.0b3 it opened under the Operations panel.
Operation names in the Operations panel and the Updates card follow the interface language.
With Composer 1.7.0b4 the repair preview lists the maintenance-page migration before you apply it.
Includes 1.13.0b3: services load on open, logs of every service, icon actions, one-row admin rail (Composer 1.7.0b3+).
Includes 1.13.0b2: the Operations panel. Includes 1.13.0b1: the maintenance page moves into the Composer image (stack schema 3).
